messages: maria: Quick design review — updated spend breakdown mock in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (frame 'spend_v3'). I tried collapsing the token legend into a hover to save vertical space. Thoughts on org vs project default? Screenshot attached. ajay: Looks much cleaner. Collapse helps on mobile but worried about discoverability — maybe show a compact legend row + a 'Show details' CTA. louise: :a11y: Contrast nit — the thin sparkline (gray #6B6B6B) vs bg (#FFFFFF) is under 4.5:1 on 1x. Also screen-reader order: chart title should include timeframe and scope (e.g., 'Monthly spend — Organization: Acme Corp'). sam: From engineering: hover card for token breakdown is doable but we have ~200ms budget to render hover before it feels sluggish. If we preload all breakdowns it'll add requests/cost. Suggest lazy-load details on first hover and cache. maria: Good point. What about a global toggle under user preferences: 'Default scope: Org / Project' plus a quick scope switch on the page itself? That way teams can pick their default and still switch easily. ajay: I like the page switch. For defaults maybe use role: org-admin -> org by default; regular dev -> project by default; fallback to last-used preference. louise: Invoice export accessibility: keep 'Download CSV' adjacent to invoice list, not buried in the kebab menu. For screen readers use an aria-label like: 'Download invoices as CSV for Organization Acme Corp, March 2026'. sam: We already have an endpoint that supports scope param (/api/invoices?scope=org). Wiring the button is trivial. Backend can stream CSV. Small perf note: don't fetch full invoice rows in UI before export click. sam: Code snippet suggestion for the link/button aria-label: ``` Download CSV ``` maria: Nice. Louise — can you add exact color tokens and contrast targets to the Figma file? I'll update the frame and add interaction notes about hover preload/cache and the scope toggle. louise: Will do. I'll also run a quick contrast scan and drop a checklist in the Figma comments. Also proposing a keyboard shortcut: press 'S' to focus the spend chart filter — small but helpful a11y win. ajay: Micro UX nit: token breakdown tooltip should show absolute token counts AND percentage, not only percent. Users want raw token numbers for billing recon. sam: Agreed, trivial change on the frontend. Also recommend debouncing hover requests to 100ms to avoid flapping when users move the mouse quickly. maria: :thumbsup: I'll push an updated frame by EOD and tag everyone. If no objections I'll sync with eng tomorrow for rollout plan (canary on dedicated, then hosted). design-bot: Contrast scan report: 3 issues found in frame 'spend_v3' — 1) sparkline contrast below threshold, 2) legend text weight too light on small type, 3) scope toggle missing accessible name. See comments in Figma.
